content:
Goal: Create a visually stunning modern recipe card for {argument name="cocktail name" default="Mojito"}, presented as a luxurious tropical social-media recipe poster.

Canvas: Vertical 2:3 portrait layout, bright white background with soft beach-and-ocean blur behind the hero drink, airy margins, watercolor lime-green splashes around the edges, subtle mint leaf textures, gold ornamental line accents, and a fresh upscale cocktail-bar aesthetic.

Layout: Top-left title area with a tiny gold cocktail icon, the small uppercase label “CUBAN SUMMER DRINK,” a huge flowing dark-green script title “Mojito,” then the tagline “cool • citrusy • refreshing.” Under it add a short description: “A classic Cuban cocktail with crisp mint, zesty lime, and a splash of sunshine.” Add a handwritten line: “Sip. Relax. Repeat.” On the right side place a tall crystal highball glass filled with crushed ice, lime wedges, mint leaves, bubbles, and condensation, garnished with a lime wheel and mint sprig; include tropical palm shadows and limes/mint on the table.

Ingredients section: Create one elegant bordered card labeled “INGREDIENTS” with exactly 6 ingredient rows, each with a small watercolor-style icon and text: 1) “1 Lime” with subtext “cut into wedges,” 2) “10–12 Mint Leaves” with subtext “fresh & fragrant,” 3) “Soda Water” with subtext “to top up,” 4) “2 tsp Sugar” with subtext “adjust to taste,” 5) “60 ml White Rum” with subtext “(2 oz),” 6) “Crushed Ice” with subtext “as much as you love.”

Tip card: To the right of the ingredients, add one smaller pale-green bordered card with mint illustration and exactly 2 text blocks: top label “TIP” with the note “Lightly crush mint — don’t over-muddle,” and bottom label “PERFECT BALANCE” with “1 Lime : 2 tsp Sugar” plus handwritten text “sweet, citrusy, just right!”

How-to section: Along the lower half, add the heading “HOW TO MAKE THE PERFECT MOJITO” and exactly 5 numbered illustrated steps connected by small gold arrows: 1) muddling mint, sugar, and lime in a glass with a wooden muddler, caption “Muddle mint leaves with sugar and lime. Gently press to release the flavors.” 2) filling a glass with crushed ice, caption “Fill glass with crushed ice. Crushed ice = maximum chill.” 3) pouring white rum and soda water into the glass, caption “Pour white rum and soda water. Add rum, then top up with soda water.” 4) stirring with a bar spoon, caption “Stir gently for balanced flavor. Mix lightly to keep it refreshing.” 5) finished mojito with mint sprig and lime wheel, caption “Garnish with mint sprig and lime wheel. The final touch of summer.”

Footer: Add small uppercase text “REFRESHING • VIBRANT • TIMELESS” and handwritten gold script “Made for sunny days and good vibes!” with a small heart doodle. Decorate the corners with watercolor lime slices, mint sprigs, ice cubes, bubbles, and splashes.

Visual style: Minimal yet artistic, polished editorial recipe-card design, watercolor botanical accents mixed with realistic cocktail photography, fresh lime green, mint green, white, pale aqua, and muted gold. Use elegant serif/sans-serif typography paired with large hand-lettered script for the title.

Constraints: Keep all text legible, maintain the exact counts of 6 ingredient rows, 2 tip-card text blocks, and 5 numbered preparation steps. No people, no watermark, no extra recipe steps, no clutter.

Create a whimsical fantasy anime illustration of a tiny enchanted garden sealed inside a clear round glass jar with a cork stopper. The jar sits on an antique wooden desk in a dim, warm study, surrounded by old books, small loose pink blossoms, and softly blurred vintage ornaments in the background. Inside the jar is a miniature sunlit flower garden: one young anime girl with {argument name="hair color" default="soft blonde"} shoulder-length hair kneels in the center, smiling with closed eyes and blushing cheeks, hands gently held near her face in a delighted pose. She wears a {argument name="dress style" default="pale blue-white floral summer dress with short sheer sleeves and a ribbon waist"}. Around her are exactly four main garden elements: a dense flowering bush on the left filled with pink daisy-like blossoms, a leafy flowering arch on the right with tiny pink flowers, a small rustic wooden picket fence behind her on the right, and a mossy winding garden path beneath her. Use glowing golden sunlight streaming from above into the jar, sparkling dust motes, lush green foliage, and many small pink flowers. Emphasize the thick curved glass rim, reflections, refractions, highlights, and slight distortion from the transparent bottle. Style: highly detailed painterly anime, magical diorama, cozy vintage atmosphere, cinematic depth of field, warm amber lighting, ultra-detailed foliage and glass, vertical composition, no text, no watermark.

Goal: Create a complete anime character design sheet for {argument name="character name" default="Goku"} in the classic Dragon Ball style, on a bright clean white/light-gray presentation background, like a professional character reference board. Make him highly recognizable with spiky black hair, orange martial arts gi, blue undershirt, blue wristbands, blue belt, blue boots with red accents, and a brown monkey tail. Use crisp cel-shaded anime line art, neat panel borders, small technical annotations, and navy-blue section tabs.

Canvas: Wide horizontal character sheet, approximately 16:9, dense but clean layout, divided into multiple rectangular panels with thin gray borders. Use a white background with pale gray grid/panel divisions and dark blue label ribbons.

Layout and exact visible element counts:
- Left biography column: 1 large title reading {argument name="headline text" default="GOKU"}, 1 small orange subtitle/mark beside it, 2 short blocks of tiny descriptive text, and 1 large circular kanji-style emblem.
- Main turnaround panel: exactly 4 full-body standing views of the character, labeled as front, side, back, and three-quarter/front pose. All 4 wear the same orange-and-blue outfit and show the tail where visible.
- Action pose panel: exactly 1 dynamic crouching/fighting pose with fists raised and tail visible.
- Sitting pose panel: exactly 1 cross-legged seated pose.
- Face close-up panel: exactly 1 large head-and-hair close-up.
- Costume and anatomy detail strip: exactly 6 detail items, including 1 hair silhouette, 1 boot detail, 1 pair of open hands, 1 fist/hand detail, 1 torso/gi fabric close-up, and 1 set of red staff/weapon line details.
- Expression row: exactly 5 head/expression busts, showing neutral, serious, determined, shouting, and powered-up battle expression with golden energy hair/aura.
- Scale comparison panel: exactly 6 standing character silhouettes/figures in a lineup, including the main character plus five other Dragon Ball-inspired figures of different heights.
- Color palette panel: exactly 6 labeled swatch groups: skin tones, hair blacks, outfit orange tones, blue clothing tones, belt/boot dark tones, and red accent tones.

Subject details: The character should have large spiky black hair, athletic childlike-to-teen proportions, expressive anime eyes, orange sleeveless gi with dark blue undershirt, blue sash belt, blue wristbands, dark blue boots with red trim, and a brown tail. The back view should show a circular kanji emblem on the gi. The action pose should feel energetic and martial-arts focused. The expression row should include one dramatic Super Saiyan-like powered-up variant with golden hair and fiery yellow aura.

Text style: Use mostly tiny faux-production notes and technical labels that look like a character design bible; keep the main title readable. Use {argument name="style label" default="CHARACTER DESIGN SHEET"} as a recurring dark-blue tab label where appropriate.

Visual style: 1990s shonen anime production sheet, clean cel shading, black ink outlines, warm orange and deep blue color scheme, precise model-sheet presentation, high detail, no photorealism.

Constraints: Keep exactly the element counts listed above. Do not add extra characters outside the scale lineup. Do not use a dark background. No watermark, no logo overlay, no messy collage effects.

Create a vertical cinematic anime action illustration of {argument name="character name" default="a fierce young female martial artist"} inside an old wooden Japanese dojo. She has {argument name="hair color" default="long flowing pink hair"} whipping dramatically through the air, sharp green eyes, and a determined expression. She wears a loose white karate gi with short sleeves, a deep open neckline, wrapped forearms and fists, and a black belt, captured mid-lunge at extreme speed with her lower body blurred into a twisting motion trail. The camera is low and close, tilted dynamically, with strong perspective and motion blur. To the right, a tall rectangular straw tatami target board is being struck and splintered, tilted toward the viewer; show exactly 8 visible metal shuriken: 6 embedded in the straw board, 1 flying near the character’s hair, and 1 small distant shuriken in the background. Add flying straw fragments, dust, sparks, and wind streaks around the impact. The dojo background includes wooden beams, tatami flooring, shoji windows with warm sunlight, training equipment, and atmospheric particles. Use dramatic golden backlighting, high-detail painterly anime rendering, realistic fabric folds, dynamic hair strands, cinematic depth of field, and intense action energy. No text, no watermark, no extra characters.

Create a dynamic vertical anime action illustration of {argument name="character name" default="a fierce young female martial artist"} in a traditional Japanese dojo, captured at a low tilted camera angle with cinematic motion blur. She has {argument name="hair color" default="long flowing pink hair"} whipping violently through the air, sharp green eyes, bandaged fists, and a white karate gi with a black belt, the gi loosened from movement but still martial and battle-ready. She is lunging forward in a powerful spinning kick or rush attack across tatami mats, kicking up dust, straw fibers, splinters, and wind trails. To the right, a large rectangular tatami mat shield or practice target is thrown upright and tilted diagonally, its woven surface scraping the floor and bursting with sparks and debris as it blocks incoming weapons. Include exactly 12 visible metal shuriken: 8 embedded in or striking the upright tatami shield, 2 flying near the character’s hair and upper body, and 2 scattered or skimming near the floor in the foreground. The dojo interior has wooden beams, shoji windows, warm late-afternoon sunlight, deep shadows, shelves and training objects in the background, and a damaged tatami floor. Use {argument name="visual style" default="high-detail cinematic anime realism"}, dramatic backlighting, glowing rim light through the hair, flying particles, shallow depth of field, intense speed lines, and a sense of impact frozen in time. No text, no watermark, no extra characters.

Create a polished anime-style illustration of two young adult cat-eared women sparring playfully inside a traditional Japanese dojo with tatami mats. The left character is {argument name="left character" default="a short brown-haired catgirl with brown cat ears"}, barefoot, wearing a dark athletic romper with black shorts and a cropped navy jacket with white sleeve cuffs; she stands in a wide martial-arts stance with one palm raised defensively and the other hand near her chest. The right character is {argument name="right character" default="a short black-haired catgirl with black cat ears"}, barefoot, wearing a beige blazer over a black sleeveless top and high-waisted black shorts; she lunges forward with one fist extended as if striking and the other fist held back. Place exactly two main characters in the scene, both full-body, dynamic, energetic, and facing each other. Between them, create a magical effect made of exactly two large iridescent soap-bubble swirls near their hips plus a looping translucent ribbon of bubbles around their hands, with many small floating bubbles catching rainbow highlights. The dojo should have warm wooden beams, sliding panels, a mirrored wall on the right reflecting gym equipment, shelves with blue training pads or weights, framed pictures on the wall, and a large window on the left showing {argument name="outside view" default="a bright snowy mountain landscape"}. Use soft afternoon sunlight streaming through the window, long shadows across the tatami, cinematic composition, clean linework, detailed anime rendering, glossy bubble reflections, soft depth of field, and a calm yet action-filled atmosphere. Keep the characters' faces softly obscured or blurred, with no readable text and no watermark.

Using the provided reference photo as the unchanged base, add an emotional Instagram-style handwritten annotation overlay in thin white ink, as if written directly on the image. Do not change the croissant, coffee, table, lighting, crop, or background; only add typography, underlines, arrows, small doodle marks, and a heart.

Overlay style: casual Japanese hand lettering, warm cafe diary mood, slightly imperfect strokes, white chalk/paint-pen look, with thin arrows pointing to the croissant and cup. Keep the writing readable but natural, with varied sizes and spacing.

Add exactly 9 discrete handwritten text blocks:
1. Large top-left headline: {argument name="headline text" default="朝のごほうび"}, with double underline and small sparkle strokes.
2. Smaller line beneath it: {argument name="subtitle text" default="焼きたての香りで 今日がはじまる。"}, with a long curved underline.
3. Left-middle note pointing toward the croissant: {argument name="butter note" default="バターの香り、ふわり"}.
4. Lower-left note pointing to the croissant tip: "先端まで きれい".
5. Center note pointing to the glossy top: "表面の照りが たまらない".
6. Upper-right note pointing to the croissant layers: "さくっと 軽い層".
7. Bottom-center note with underline near the plate: "この立体感が好き".
8. Lower-right note pointing to the coffee cup: "やさしい一口".
9. Bottom handwritten closing phrase: {argument name="closing phrase" default="なんでもない朝が、少し好きになる。♡"}, underlined.

Composition: place most writing in the empty darker wall/window area and around the food without covering the main croissant too heavily. Use curved arrows, dotted emphasis marks, wavy underlines, and small decorative strokes to connect notes to the croissant and coffee. Avoid adding any logos, borders, stickers, or extra objects.

Create a cute sticker-sheet style character illustration on a clean white background: exactly 9 small chibi mascot drawings arranged in a neat 3-by-3 grid with generous spacing. The character is a fluffy cream puppy-like creature with floppy ears tipped in turquoise-blue, a small blue tuft/mark on the chest, big glossy dark eyes, blushy pink cheeks, tiny paws, and a stylized lightning-bolt tail colored yellow with blue accents. Use soft hand-drawn anime line art, slightly sketchy black outlines, pastel watercolor/crayon shading, rounded proportions, and expressive kawaii faces. Show these 9 distinct poses and expressions: top left surprised with mouth open, one paw raised, black exclamation marks around the head; top center delighted and waving both arms, tongue out, smiling; top right pouting/annoyed with one eye squeezed shut, cheeks puffed, small steam-puff marks around the head; middle left crying sadly with downturned mouth and exactly 4 blue teardrops around/under the eyes; middle center happily giggling with eyes closed, one paw raised, pink blush, a small pink heart and handwritten Japanese text “え〜” beside it; middle right confused and bashful, looking upward with exactly 2 black question marks and a small black heart-like doodle above; bottom left sleepy with eyes closed, droopy posture, and exactly 3 handwritten “z” sleep marks; bottom center shy/cute neutral expression with big eyes, tiny mouth, and exactly 3 small pink hearts around it; bottom right cheerful approval pose with one paw making a gesture, tongue out, energetic marks near the paw, and handwritten text “OK!” above. Keep all characters the same design and scale, no borders, no background props, no extra characters, no watermark.

Create a photorealistic vertical summer snapshot of {argument name="number of students" default="three"} Japanese high school girls cleaning an outdoor school swimming pool area on a bright sunny day, styled like a nostalgic candid youth magazine photo. The scene is poolside on wet concrete with the blue pool and metal fence in the background, leafy greenery and a pale blue sky with soft clouds behind them. All faces should be anonymized with soft square mosaic blur blocks, matching a privacy-blurred social-media photo. The students wear matching summer school uniforms: crisp white short-sleeve button-up shirts, navy striped neckties, and blue plaid pleated skirts, barefoot on the wet ground. Count exactly 3 students: the left student stands holding a blue garden hose spraying water onto the pavement and carries a navy shoulder bag with a small plush keychain; the center student leans forward toward the camera while scrubbing the wet concrete with a long-handled deck brush; the right student stands confidently with one hand on her hip while holding a plastic cup of bubble tea with a red straw. Include exactly 5 main cleaning/accessory items: 1 blue hose with visible splashing water, 1 long-handled brush with green bristles, 1 turquoise bucket on the right foreground, 1 white towel draped over the bucket edge, and 1 drink cup with tapioca pearls. Use natural sunlight, realistic water reflections, sparkling droplets, shallow depth of field, soft lens flare, and a small rainbow reflection near the bottom foreground. Composition should be full-body, slightly low eye-level, portrait 9:16, centered on the middle student and framed to show the poolside environment. Keep the mood wholesome, casual, cheerful, and summery; avoid text, logos, exaggerated poses, or fantasy elements.

Create a photorealistic Minecraft-style screenshot of {argument name="character description" default="a real adult male hiker seen from behind, wearing a beige bucket hat, muted teal T-shirt, dark shorts, black hiking shoes, and a large black backpack"} sitting on a blocky gray stone ledge in the lower-left foreground, looking into a lush voxel forest valley. Keep the person realistic and natural while transforming the entire environment into Minecraft-like cubic blocks. The scene should show a clear shallow stream running from the foreground center into the distance, made of transparent blue pixelated water with bright square sunlight reflections. On both sides of the stream are stepped cube terrain blocks: grass blocks with dirt sides, mossy gray stone blocks, small square platforms, and many tall blocky grass tufts. In the midground, place a simple wooden plank bridge crossing the stream horizontally, supported by stone-block pillars. Surround the stream with dense blocky trees: many tall brown pixelated trunks and cubic leafy green canopies forming a bright forest corridor. The sky is visible through the treetops as vivid blue with a few rectangular white Minecraft-style clouds. Use {argument name="lighting style" default="warm midday sunlight with dappled forest shadows"}, vibrant greens, crisp voxel geometry, high detail, cinematic depth, and realistic global illumination. Camera angle: wide landscape composition, eye-level to slightly low, looking upstream toward the bridge, with the hiker occupying the lower-left third and the stream leading the eye to the center. No text, no UI, no watermark, no extra characters.

Create a cinematic Minecraft-style screenshot of a lone real human hiker walking away from the camera through a dense blocky forest. The person should remain realistic rather than voxelized: an adult man seen from behind, wearing a light beige wide-brim hiking hat, muted teal short-sleeve shirt, dark gray shorts, black hiking shoes, and a large black backpack, centered slightly left on a dirt-and-stone trail. Transform the entire environment into a vivid Minecraft world made of cubes: tall square-trunk trees with pixelated bark, cubic leafy canopies, stepped grassy dirt banks on both sides, blocky gray stone cubes, pixelated tall grass, and a winding path of brown dirt and cobblestone blocks leading into the distance. Use bright midday sunlight filtering through the trees, strong dappled shadows, saturated greens, blue sky with blocky white clouds visible through the canopy, high detail, wide-angle adventure-game composition, realistic lighting with voxel geometry, no text, no UI, no watermark. Customize the subject as {argument name="main subject" default="adult male hiker"}, clothing as {argument name="outfit" default="beige hiking hat, muted teal T-shirt, dark gray shorts, black backpack"}, setting as {argument name="environment" default="dense Minecraft forest trail"}, lighting as {argument name="lighting" default="bright midday sun with dappled shadows"}, and camera view as {argument name="camera view" default="rear view, eye-level wide shot"}.

Create a realistic travel-photo composition transformed into a Minecraft-style open-world screenshot. Show one human figure viewed from behind, standing near the lower left foreground on a grassy blocky cliff, looking out over a vast bright blue ocean and rugged voxel coastline. The person should remain photorealistic and natural, wearing {argument name="outfit" default="a tan wide-brim hiking hat, navy blue T-shirt, dark shorts, and black sneakers"}, with relaxed posture and hands by the sides, facing the scenery. The entire environment must be rendered as Minecraft-like cubic blocks: square grass and dirt ledges in the foreground, tall pixelated grass clumps, stepped rocky gray block formations along the shore, turquoise shallow water with white surf around the rocks, a deep cobalt ocean stretching to the horizon, and a green blocky forested coastline with hills and mountains in the distance. Use {argument name="scene location" default="a tropical coastal cliff overlooking the ocean"} as the setting. The sky is vivid clear blue with exactly many flat rectangular white voxel clouds scattered across the upper half, strong midday sunlight, saturated colors, crisp shadows, and high contrast. Camera angle is a wide landscape view from slightly behind and above the person, emphasizing scale and adventure, like a screenshot from an upgraded high-resolution Minecraft shader pack mixed with a real person. Keep the person anatomically realistic, not blocky, while all terrain, water edges, rocks, plants, clouds, and distant mountains are voxel/block-based. No text, no UI, no watermark.

Create a photorealistic Minecraft-style screenshot showing {argument name="main subject" default="an adult man fishing from a folding camping chair"} beside a calm lake. Keep the human subject realistic and unchanged in proportions and clothing, but transform the entire environment into a bright blocky voxel world inspired by Minecraft. The scene is viewed from behind and slightly above the seated person on the lower left foreground: he wears a light beige wide-brim sun hat, dark gray T-shirt, dark shorts, and black sneakers, holding a long thin fishing rod angled diagonally out over the water. He sits on a black collapsible camping chair on a stepped grassy dirt block shoreline. Surround him with tall square reeds and pixelated grass. The lake fills the right half of the image, with transparent blue blocky water, subtle square reflections, exactly 7 visible green lily pads scattered on the surface, and small white square highlights. Across the lake is a dense voxel forest with oak and birch trees, layered grassy banks, dirt blocks, trunks, leaves, and undergrowth. The sky is vivid clear blue with exactly 13 rectangular white block clouds at different sizes and distances. Use crisp sunlight, saturated greens and blues, realistic lighting and shadows, high-resolution game screenshot quality, strong contrast between the realistic person and the fully Minecraft-like environment, no UI, no text, no watermark.

Create a premium commercial advertising poster for {argument name="product name" default="Samsung Galaxy S26 Ultra"} in a sleek modern Samsung flagship style. Use a vertical poster canvas with a dark futuristic navy-black background, soft gradients, subtle blue and silver glow accents, glossy reflections, and high-end studio lighting. Place the white SAMSUNG logo in the top-left corner. Center a large bold headline reading “Galaxy S26 Ultra”, with a smaller glowing blue subtitle “The Latest AI Phone” beneath it and the tagline “Power. Precision. Intelligence.” below that. In the center, show two premium silver smartphones standing upright: the left phone shows the back with a matte silver finish and a multi-lens camera cluster with exactly 5 visible camera/sensor circles arranged near the top-left; the right phone shows the front display with thin bezels, a centered punch-hole camera, and an abstract metallic geometric wallpaper in silver, black, and lavender tones. Add a silver S Pen standing diagonally to the left of the phones. Behind the devices, add a glowing partial blue halo ring and a horizontal light flare at the base, with the phones reflected on a glossy floor. Along the lower third, create a clean spec bar with exactly 6 feature items in two rows of three, separated by thin vertical dividers and simple outline icons: 1) phone icon with “6.9” Dynamic AMOLED display”, 2) camera icon with “200MP pro-grade camera”, 3) chip icon with “Snapdragon® 8 Elite Gen 5 for Galaxy”, 4) pen icon with “Built-in S Pen”, 5) battery icon with “5000mAh battery”, 6) shield/lock icon with “Privacy Display”. At the bottom center, add the call-to-action “Now available” and the supporting line “Galaxy AI built for your everyday.” with two small sparkle symbols. Use crisp white and pale blue typography, centered alignment, premium spacing, realistic product rendering, metallic edges, and no extra text or watermarks.

Create a hyper-realistic surreal luxury fashion magazine cover in a vertical 4:5 format. The image is an extreme macro close-up of a woman's open mouth filling the entire frame, with glossy deep burgundy-red lips, wet specular highlights, visible lipstick texture, and warm brown skin cropped tightly around the lips. The mouth is wide open into a dark black interior like a stage or portal. Across the upper teeth is an extravagant diamond-encrusted grill: exactly 10 visible upper tooth caps arranged in an arch, each outlined in polished yellow gold, with white diamond pavé surfaces; include rectangular baguette diamond panels on two lower sections near the left-center and right-center caps, plus smaller side caps receding into shadow. Inside the open mouth, place one full-body adult man crouching forward as if emerging from the darkness; he wears a dark navy tailored suit, white dress shirt, black tie, and shiny black leather gloves, one gloved hand resting on the lower lip in the foreground and the other bracing at the side. His face should be intentionally obscured/blurred by a plain skin-tone rectangular censor block while his black hair remains visible. Add a high-fashion cover masthead: enormous elegant white serif letters spelling {argument name="magazine title" default="LUXE"} across the top, partially overlaying the upper lip; small spaced white text {argument name="subtitle" default="MAGAZINE"} at upper left beneath the masthead; tiny white issue text {argument name="issue text" default="SUMMER 2024"} near the top right. Use dramatic studio lighting, glossy reflections, crisp photorealistic detail, shallow depth of field, editorial surrealism, luxury jewelry advertising aesthetics, no extra text, no watermark.

Create a wide cinematic photorealistic scene in a sunlit stone quarry at golden hour, showing two versions of the same adult man: on the left, {argument name="character name" default="the sculptor"}, a dusty quarry worker in an olive-green t-shirt, dark cargo pants, work boots, and protective safety glasses, standing close to the statue while holding a hammer in one hand and a chisel in the other; on the right, a life-sized white marble statue of the same man seated on a rectangular stone block, wearing a long simple tunic or kurta-like robe with soft carved folds, hands resting on the knees, legs crossed at the ankles, and a large circular stone halo disk behind the head. The sculptor is actively chiseling the statue near the neck and shoulder, with bright marble dust particles exploding into the warm backlight. The quarry walls rise tall in the background, with scaffolding, ropes, stone blocks, and exactly 5 background quarry workers wearing light work clothes and helmets: one standing on left scaffolding, one farther behind him, one on the right scaffolding, one seated or crouched near the lower right, and one small figure walking at the far right. Use dramatic sunlight streaming from the upper left, volumetric dust, shallow depth of field, realistic stone texture, warm beige and gray color grading, rugged industrial atmosphere, high-detail cinema lighting, 3:4 vertical composition, medium-wide framing, no text, no watermark. The visible faces should be neutral and unobtrusive, with the sculptor and statue clearly sharing the same identity; use {argument name="sculptor outfit color" default="dusty olive green"} for the worker clothing and {argument name="statue material" default="white marble"} for the statue.

Create a vertical retro cartoon travel postcard for {argument name="city name" default="Chengdu"}. Use a bold vintage comic-book style with thick black outlines, bright pop-art colors, visible halftone dot texture, slightly grainy aged print, and playful exaggerated perspective. The sky is saturated cyan-blue with comic dots. At the very top, place huge arched yellow block letters reading {argument name="headline text" default="CHENGDU"}, with black shadow and outline; directly underneath add red Chinese characters {argument name="local city text" default="成都"} flanked by two red dots. In the upper right, add a red circular passport stamp that says “WELCOME TO CHENGDU” with a cute panda face and three wavy postal cancellation lines. The scene should show exactly 5 cream-and-peach puffy clouds: one large cloud on the upper left, one large cloud on the upper right, one partial cloud entering from the left middle edge, one small cloud left of center, and one small cloud right of center. Center the postcard around Chengdu landmarks: a tall TV tower rising from behind a giant faceted panda-head building, with a blue doorway at the panda’s mouth; make the panda head geometric and stone-like with black ears and eye patches. Along the lower skyline, include colorful simplified city buildings and green trees. On the left foreground, include a traditional Chinese pavilion with green tiled roofs, red lanterns, and a sign with Chinese characters. On the right foreground, include a yellow vertical sign with Chinese characters {argument name="landmark sign text" default="太古里"}. Across the bottom, draw a bright blue river with wavy white highlights and an arched cream stone bridge on the right. In the bottom left foreground, place a roadside sign reading “I ♥ CHENGDU” and a cute standing panda mascot waving beside it. Counted visible elements: 1 main headline, 1 Chinese subtitle, 1 red passport stamp, 5 clouds, 1 central TV tower, 1 giant panda-head building, 1 traditional pavilion, 1 vertical landmark sign, 1 river, 1 arched bridge, 1 “I love Chengdu” sign, and 1 waving panda mascot. Keep the composition busy but legible, like a cheerful tourist souvenir postcard, with no photorealism and no extra text beyond the specified lettering.

Create a cinematic, realistic 4:3 landscape photograph of two young people lying on their backs in a dry golden wheat field at sunset, viewed from a very low angle among tall grass stems in the foreground. The scene should feel quiet, nostalgic, and intimate, with warm late-afternoon backlight, hazy sun flare from the upper left, soft film grain, shallow depth of field, and muted earthy colors. The person on the left wears a {argument name="left outfit" default="loose white short-sleeve shirt"} and lies slightly farther back with one arm bent near the head; the person on the right wears a {argument name="right outfit" default="white sleeveless floral top"} and lies closer to the camera, partially cropped at the lower edge. Their bodies are relaxed and partly hidden by wheat stalks. Place exactly two opaque dark brown rectangular censor blocks over their faces, one centered over each face, with no visible facial features. In the background, show an expansive rural field, a dark tree line, soft distant hills, and exactly three thin utility or communication poles rising on the horizon. Use natural imperfect framing, foreground grass blur, golden-hour rim light, and a documentary fashion-photography look. No text, no watermark, no extra people.

Create a cinematic black-and-white fine-art photograph of {argument name="subject" default="a ghostly ballerina"} dancing alone inside {argument name="location" default="an abandoned old theater or ballroom"}. The dancer is positioned slightly right of center, wearing a translucent knee-length ballet dress and pointe shoes, with her arms extended in an elegant, fragile pose; use a long-exposure multiple-exposure effect so her body appears as two or three overlapping semi-transparent silhouettes, suggesting motion and haunting presence. The room is dark, decayed, and atmospheric, with cracked plaster, an arched alcove or stage opening on the right, rows of shadowed seats or debris in the background, and tall broken arched windows on the left. Strong sunlight blasts through the window from the left rear, creating visible shafts of dusty light, smoky haze, high-contrast rim lighting, and a bright rectangular patch of light on the wooden floor beneath the dancer. Use {argument name="lighting style" default="dramatic backlight with volumetric dust beams"}, deep blacks, glowing highlights, film grain, soft blur from movement, and a moody gothic mood. Compose in a horizontal 4:3 frame, wide interior view, low-to-mid camera height, with the dancer small enough to show the environment. No text, no modern objects, no color, no clean studio look.

Create a cinematic 35mm film photograph of a lone person in a long dark coat standing near the center of an abandoned industrial warehouse at golden hour.
